title: 拜靖国神社，日本再次撕下自己的“和平伪装”（钟声）

summary_en: A People's Daily 'Bell' article noted that Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae made offerings to Yasukuni Shrine in the name of 'Prime Minister' on Oct 17, and on Oct 19 entrusted a senior LDP official to offer ritual fees; many political figures made offerings and visits during the autumn festival. summary: 《生物多样性公约》第十七次缔约方大会在埃里温开幕，将首次全球审查“昆蒙框架”落实进展。国际货币基金组织、世界银行与泰国央行发布“曼谷蓝图”，呼吁跨境合作打击金融诈骗。伊朗总统表示绝不屈服于“侵略性”国家无理要求与霸凌，军方称已制定应对方案。

Iran's president said Iran will never yield to unreasonable demands and bullying from 'aggressive' countries, and the military said response plans are in place.

summary: 普埃布拉彩陶是跨太平洋文化交流的产物。16世纪中叶西班牙开辟马尼拉至阿卡普尔科航线，中国青花瓷传入新西班牙，普埃布拉成为消费、分销与再创造节点。17至18世纪，当地陶工行会要求精品陶器模仿中国青花样式与晕染技法，陶工结合伊比利亚锡釉陶和中国
summary_en: Puebla polychrome pottery is a product of trans-Pacific cultural exchange. In the mid-16th century, Spain opened the Manila-Acapulco route, Chinese blue-and-white porcelain reached New Spain, and Puebla became a hub for consumption, distribution and re-creation. In the 17th and 18th centuries, local potters' guilds required fine ceramics to imitate Chinese blue-and-white styles and shading techniques, and potters combined Iberian tin-glazed pottery with Chinese blue-and-white techniques.

title: 深化对话与务实合作，共促北极可持续发展（国际视点）
title_en: Deepening dialogue and practical cooperation to promote sustainable development in the Arctic (International Viewpoint)
summary: 北极圈论坛大会期间举行“如何理解中国”全会，中方表示北极面临气候变化、海冰融化等共同挑战，各国应将更多资源投入科研与环保合作。中国作为近北极国家，1925年加入《斯匹次卑尔根群岛条约》，2004年建成黄河站，2013年成为北极理事会正式观察
summary_en: During the Arctic Circle Assembly, a plenary session titled 'How to Understand China' was held. The Chinese side said the Arctic faces common challenges such as climate change and melting sea ice, and that countries should devote more resources to scientific research and environmental cooperation. As a near-Arctic country, China joined the Spitsbergen Treaty in 1925, built the Yellow River Station in 2004, and became an official observer to the Arctic Council in 2013.

title: 汇聚工商界力量  共建亚太共同体
title_en: Pool the strength of the business community to jointly build an Asia-Pacific community
summary: 文章指出，习近平主席就共建亚太共同体提出系列理念主张。2026年11月中国将在深圳举办APEC第三十三次领导人非正式会议及工商领导人峰会。工商界被视为引领亚太和世界经济增长的重要力量，在开放融通、创新发展、合作共赢中发挥贡献者、动力源和压舱
summary_en: The article noted that President Xi Jinping has put forward a series of ideas and propositions on building an Asia-Pacific community. In November 2026, China will host the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting and the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen. The business community is seen as an important force leading economic growth in the Asia-Pacific and the world, serving as a contributor, engine and ballast in openness, innovation and win-win cooperation.

title: 李强在中朝新鸭绿江大桥开通仪式上发表视频致辞
title_en: Li Qiang delivers video address at opening ceremony of new China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge
summary: 李强在中朝新鸭绿江大桥开通仪式上发表视频致辞时表示，该大桥是两党两国最高领导人共同关心推动的重要跨境基础设施项目，顺利开通将有力促进两国经贸合作和人员往来，成为中朝传统友谊新地标。他希望以大桥开通为契机，优化口岸通关，提升互联互通水平，挖掘
summary_en: In a video address at the opening ceremony of the new Yalu River Bridge between China and North Korea, Li Qiang said the bridge is an important cross-border infrastructure project jointly championed by the top leaders of the two parties and countries, and its smooth opening will greatly promote economic and trade cooperation and personnel exchanges between the two countries, becoming a new landmark of traditional China-DPRK friendship. He expressed hope that the bridge's opening will be an opportunity to improve port clearance, enhance connectivity, and tap cooperation potential.

summary_en: Bater led a delegation from the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference to visit Guyana.
